# netbox_device_power_outlet (Data Source)

Retrieves a single device power outlet from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_device_power_outlet" "example" {
  name      = "example"
  device_id = 1
}

output "device_power_outlet_id" {
  value = data.netbox_device_power_outlet.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the device power outlet.

### Optional

- `cable_id` (Number) The ID of the cable associated with the device power outlet.
- `device_id` (Number) The ID of the device associated with the device power outlet.
- `module_id` (Number) The ID of the module associated with the device power outlet.

### Read-Only

- `cable_end` (String) The cable end of the device power outlet.
- `color` (String) The color of the device power outlet.
- `connected_endpoints_reachable` (Boolean) The connected endpoints reachable of the device power outlet.
- `connected_endpoints_type` (String) The connected endpoints type of the device power outlet.
- `created` (String) When the device power outlet was created.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the device power outlet, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the device power outlet.
- `feed_leg` (String) The feed leg of the device power outlet.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `label` (String) The label of the device power outlet.
- `last_updated` (String) When the device power outlet was last changed.
- `link_peers_type` (String) The link peers type of the device power outlet.
- `mark_connected` (Boolean) The mark connected of the device power outlet.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the device power outlet.
- `power_port_id` (Number) The ID of the power port associated with the device power outlet.
- `status` (String) The status of the device power outlet.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
- `type` (String) The type of the device power outlet.
